name: Order of the Beacon Cavalier/Samurai Order
body:
A cavalier who belongs to this order has pledged themselves to bringing hope in the darkest of times.

Cavaliers of this order travel the land fighting those who would seek to keep others under their heel and those who rule through fear.

Edicts: The cavalier must bring hope to the downtrodden. They confront and stop any who would use fear or despair as a tool of control or a means to gain power. Since these edicts are about helping others and giving hope, they cannot be of an evil alignment.

Challenge: Whenever an order of the beacon cavalier issues a challenge, they gain a morale bonus on attack rolls and saves vs. fear and despair when they deal damage to the target of their challenge. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 levels the cavalier has (to a maximum of +5 at 16th level).

Skills: An order of the beacon cavalier adds Knowledge (local) and Knowledge (nobility) to their list of class skills. Whenever an order of the beacon cavalier uses Diplomacy to alleviate despair (See New Skill Uses), they receive a bonus on that check equal to 1/2 their cavalier level (minimum +1)

Order Abilities

A cavalier who belongs to the order of the beacon gains the following abilities as they increase in level.

Rallying Call (Ex)

At 2nd level, an order of the beacon cavalier gains the ability to rally their allies. As a standard action, they can give an encouraging speech which grants all allies within 60 feet a morale bonus on saving throws vs. fear and despair equal to their Charisma modifier and a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls for a number of rounds equal to their cavalier level. If an ally within range is under the effects of a spell or ability that causes them to be doubting, despairing or hopeless, they can immediately make another saving throw to resist the effect (if allowed).

Raise the Beacon (Ex)

At 8th level, an order of the beacon cavalier can instill hope in their allies, inspiring them to continue against the odds. As a swift action, the cavalier can double any morale bonus that allies within 30 feet are benefiting from. This increased bonus lasts for 1 round. This ability can be used once per combat.

Shield against Despair (Ex)

At 15th level, the cavalier strikes out at any enemy that would attack their allies. Whenever an enemy makes a melee attack against the cavalier or one of their adjacent allies, that enemy provokes an attack of opportunity from them, and the cavalier gains a +2 morale bonus on this attack of opportunity. If the attack is against an ally suffering from the doubting, despairing or hopeless condition, the cavalier counts the enemy as if it were the target of their challenge for this attack of opportunity.
